container-offices.narrative: What the specification changes for you. Two lines in these tables decide most site problems. The 150x75x5 mm base frame sets where the module may be supported, so your plinth positions follow it rather than the other way round. And the electrical line states starting cable sizes only: the final conductor size comes from your approved load schedule, which is why we ask for your equipment list before quoting.
